data.name: Palmiro
data.gender_notes: Palmiro is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Christian tradition, Palmiro derives from the Latin palma, meaning 'palm'. This refers to the palm of the hand, a symbol of pilgrimage and spiritual journey. In biblical context, the palm branch was a symbol of victory and triumph. The name Palmiro carries the meaning “Pilgrim's palm” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Palmiro usually hope their child will grow to embody pilgrim's palm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Palmiro belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pilgrim's palm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Palmiro total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Παλμίρο
in_greek.meaning: Παλμίρο σημαίνει ψηλό και ίσιο φοινικιά
in_greek.long_meaning: Παλμίρο είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ιταλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει ψηλό και ίσιο φοινικιά. Το όνομα συνδέεται με το σύμβολο της δικαιοσύνης, της ειρήνης και της σοφίας. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Παλμίρο συνδέεται με την εικόνα του φοινικιά, που συμβολίζει τη δύναμη και τη σταθερότητα.
